description: This file defines a custom exception class 'TableNotFoundException' used to indicate that a specific database table was not found. It is part of the 'com.romraider.xml' package and extends the standard Exception class.

classes.name: TableNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a specific database table was not located.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns a fixed message indicating that the table was not found.
